verdict.rationale: A probe found an official Stripe MCP server documented at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect to Stripe through an official MCP endpoint. Nothing in the pack shows that server exposes Treasury-specific tools such as financial accounts, outbound payments or transactions, and the evidence is a single probe line. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MCP server covers Treasury resources, documented setup, auth and tool details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
